zh.title: 國內線午後陸續恢復 民航局協調加班與放大機型
zh.summary: 國內線午後陸續恢復，民航局協調加開或放大機型25架次
body: 國內線航班午後陸續恢復後，交通部民用航空局協調航空公司加開班機或放大機型，共計25架次，其中澎湖航線17架次、金門航線8架次，提供2,251個座位。
民航局統計，截至當日18時，國內線仍有159架次取消、20架次延誤。因航班已中斷兩天，金門、澎湖仍有旅客無法順利取得機位；民航局提醒旅客先確認機位再前往機場，避免久候。

en.title: Taiwan Domestic Flights Resume as CAA Taiwan Coordinates 25 Capacity Increases
en.summary: Taiwan domestic flights resume; CAA coordinates 25 added flights or larger aircraft
body: Domestic flights in Taiwan gradually resumed during the afternoon, the Civil Aeronautics Administration said. It coordinated with airlines to add flights or use larger aircraft for a total of 25 flight operations: 17 on Penghu routes and eight on Kinmen routes, providing 2,251 seats.

As of 6 p.m., the agency said, 159 domestic flights had been canceled and 20 delayed. Because services had been interrupted for two days, some passengers in Kinmen and Penghu were still unable to obtain seats. The agency advised passengers to confirm their seats before going to the airport to avoid long waits.
